prompt.text:
Implement a read-only document index and export exactly `{ createDocumentIndex }` using CommonJS. The factory accepts an array of unique records `{ code, title, state, labels }`; `code`, `title`, and `state` are non-empty strings, and `labels` is an array of strings. Invalid data throws `TypeError`, and duplicate codes throw `RangeError`. It returns `page(number, size)`, `lookup(code)`, `byState(state, number, size)`, and `search(text, number, size)`. Page numbers and sizes are positive integers. Pagination preserves input order and returns `{ items, page, size, total }`; out-of-range pages have an empty `items` array. Search is case-insensitive over titles, and an empty search string matches every record. State matching is exact. Missing codes return `null`. Inputs and stored records must never be mutated or exposed: labels and records in every result must be fresh copies.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
